text: Register a callback with `cobra.OnInitialize(func() { ... })` instead of trying to read execution-time values directly in Go's package `init`. `OnInitialize` stores functions to run when a command's `Execute` is called (`cobra.go:97-101`), and `(*Command).preRun` executes those callbacks during command processing (`command.go:1015-1019,926-937`). Persistent flags are available from `PersistentFlags()` (`command.go:1725-1735`).
